SELECT 
    ds.date,
    ds.sku,
    ds.units_sold,
    ds.revenue_inr,
    p.cost_inr,
    (ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as cogs
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku
WHERE ds.date >= '2026-06-01' AND ds.date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY ds.date, ds.sku;

SELECT 
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) as total_revenue,
    SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as total_cogs,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) - SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as gross_profit
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku
WHERE ds.date >= '2026-06-01' AND ds.date <= '2026-06-30';

    tender,
    till_status,

    SUM(amount_inr) as total_amount
